data.body: Housekeeping: make the pre-commit ruff check green so a git push passes. 8 remaining errors after ruff check --fix already auto-fixed 15: (1) ddflow/adapters/git.py:48-53 five E402 from a merge artifact placing import os / dataclass / Path / .fsio / .proc after the Git Protocol class — move to top in isort order; (2) ddflow/services/ci/runner.py:154 _settle C901 21>15 — extract a helper to get under 15, keep the PLR0913 noqa intent; (3) runner.py:270 _run_under_slot PLR0913 11>10 — add # noqa PLR0913 with a one-line justification; (4) ddflow/services/harnessreg.py:224 PLR2004 magic 2 / args[1] — name the constant. Then ruff format the changed files so ruff format --check is clean, and confirm ruff check returns 0.
data.title: lint: housekeeping — fix remaining ruff check errors (E402/C901/PLR0913/PLR2004) so git push passes

data.claim: The local pre-push ruff check is red solely from 8 errors (5x E402 misplaced imports in ddflow/adapters/git.py, C901 _settle 21>15 and PLR0913 _run_under_slot 11>10 in ddflow/services/ci/runner.py, PLR2004 in ddflow/services/harnessreg.py) plus 15 auto-fixable F401/isort artifacts and ruff format drift; moving the imports, refactoring _settle, naming the constants and reformatting makes both ruff check and ruff format --check clean.
data.falsifier: ruff check reports any remaining error, or ruff format --check says a changed file would be reformatted, after the edits.
data.mechanism: The E402s are a merge artifact (imports after the Git Protocol class); ruff check --fix already removed 15 unused-import/isort issues, leaving only the non-auto-fixable errors and the format.
data.probe: ruff check && ruff format --check on the changed files
data.probe_output: ruff check: All checks passed (was 23 errors). ruff format --check: 11 files already formatted.
data.question: Why is the local pre-push ruff check red, and are the 8 remaining errors plus the 15 auto-fixes and format drift the whole story?

evidence.note: ruff check reported 23 errors (15 fixable, 8 not); after ruff check --fix plus the three manual fixes it reports 'All checks passed'. ruff format --check on the 11 changed files: '11 files already formatted'. Research R36e3d0fbcb CONFIRMED.

Ran 'ddflow brief --item fix-lint-ruff-check-remaining': returned the project rules digest (r-task-phase-needs-wave, r-gemini-key-load, publish-order, review-family rules) and the relevant past lessons. Applied: claim before edit (worktree), pass as_agent=fix-lint, load GEMINI_API_KEY before gemini review.

Committed 53e83d4c4 in the worktree: moved the 5 E402 imports to the top of ddflow/adapters/git.py in isort order, refactored _settle (extracted _merged_once/_busy_result/_settled_result) to pass C901, added a justified # noqa: PLR0913 to _run_under_slot, named _TABLE_VALUE_INDEX/_TABLE_HINT_ARITY in harnessreg._check_table; ruff check --fix removed 15 F401/isort artifacts; ruff format cleaned 4 files. Only touched the 11 declared globs. ruff check: All checks passed.
